title: Refract gate evidence record
description: One record per gate check per commit, written by .claude/scripts/gate-check.py to .claude/evidence/<HEAD sha>/<gate>-<check>.json. The script stamps every field; no model writes one. Inferential checks (G1 acceptance, G7 review) read the verifier's and reviewers' records, which the SubagentStop hooks stamped (verdict.schema.json, findings.schema.json). Validated against the records gate-check.py actually produces by tests/hooks/run.sh.

gate.description: Gate id from the Refract gate catalog (G0 contract, G1 functional correctness, G2 test quality, G3 security, G4 performance, G7 code quality, G12 usability and state coverage, G14 behavioural baseline, G15 governance).

verdict.description: UNVERIFIED = the check could not be run (no runner, tool missing, lane busy); it is never PASS. N-A carries the reason the change does not trigger the check.

execution.description: Whether the producer actually executed. A SKIPPED check is UNVERIFIED or N-A, never PASS.

mode.description: From .claude/gates.json, or --mode=. Only block makes a FAIL stop the Stop hook.

producer.description: computational = a tool decided; inferential = a judge decided (G1 acceptance, G7 review), and this record re-checks that judge's stamped, tree-bound record.

output_tail.description: Last lines of the producer's output, for the human reading a FAIL.

commit.description: HEAD when the record was stamped; null on an unborn branch.

base.description: The merge-base the change was measured from.

tree.description: sha256 over HEAD, the uncommitted diff and untracked files — binds the record to the exact tree it judged.

agent_type.description: Reserved: gate-check.py runs in the main session or CI and stamps null; the judge identity of an inferential gate lives in the verdict / review record it re-checks (signer.agent_type).

author_agent.description: Reserved (null): the authors of a judged change are stamped on the verdict / review record (authors[]), where G15 signer compares them with its signer.
